hyperedges.label: Detection pipeline: chunk -> NER + regex -> span merge
NER runtime chain: App -> useNer -> nerClient -> worker

nodes.label: chunk.ts sentence/paragraph chunking with overlap
nodes.rationale: Needed because of BERT 512-token limit; keeps exact offsets.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages deploy workflow (deploy.yml)
nodes.rationale: Push to main runs test + build with --base=/<repo>/ then publishes to GitHub Pages.

nodes.label: importFile.ts readTextFile (.txt/.md/.docx/.pdf)
nodes.rationale: mammoth and PDF.js legacy build lazy-loaded; PDF text layer only, no OCR.

nodes.label: ner.ts (locateEntities, detectNer, detectAll)
nodes.rationale: locateEntities re-finds char offsets since the pipeline gives none; detectNer runs chunked with injected model; detectAll is the final fusion.

nodes.label: React + TS + Vite + Tailwind v4 + Vitest
nodes.norm_label: react + ts + vite + tailwind v4 + vitest

nodes.label: mapping.ts Vault (anonymize/deanonymize, RAM only)
nodes.rationale: Mapping kept only in RAM so nothing persists; supports purge.

nodes.label: Privacy Shield
nodes.rationale: 100% local, browser-only RGPD anonymizer; no backend, no network calls with user data.

nodes.label: Graphify workflow (mandatory)
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before scanning files; read full source only when modifying; update graph after each phase or major refactor.

nodes.label: Local-only, no network with user data
nodes.norm_label: local-only, no network with user data
nodes.rationale: RGPD compliance: user data never leaves the browser; drives self-hosted model and wasm.

nodes.label: ONNX runtime wasm served locally, version pinned
nodes.norm_label: onnx runtime wasm served locally, version pinned
nodes.rationale: onnxruntime-web pinned to the exact version Transformers.js uses; bump both together. wasmPaths set in worker.

nodes.label: Self-hosted model files (fetch-model.mjs, allowRemoteModels=false)
nodes.rationale: Pinned revision downloaded into public/models/ at predev/prebuild with SHA-256 checks; MODEL/REVISION/hashes and worker MODEL_ID must change together.

nodes.label: spans.ts overlap merge (manual > regex > ner, then longer)
nodes.norm_label: spans.ts overlap merge (manual > regex > ner, then longer)
nodes.rationale: Overlapping detections resolved by source priority, then by length.

nodes.label: Strict TDD (Red -> Green)
nodes.rationale: Write Vitest tests first, confirm failure, then minimal implementation; never implement before seeing the test fail.
